name: place a reservation via the tool and record the confirmation with the company name
definition: Invoke the reservation endpoint with the chosen venue and the organization's name, then write the pair into the result file.
failure_mode: A static/fabricated file or missing names fails the content/verification checks.

name: preserve physics validity thresholds across variants
definition: run the simulation so that the normalized minimum distance and average distance metrics exceed documented thresholds; parallel runs must land within a tolerance of the serial metrics.
failure_mode: a physically broken engine prints the metrics below threshold or non-matching parallel values

name: preserve script execution for group members in the shared area
definition: ensure the ACL mask still allows members to execute scripts stored in the shared directory.
failure_mode: a mask that strips execute blocks script execution

name: prevent queued-not-started tasks from running after cancellation
definition: When multiple tasks are queued and execution is interrupted, only tasks already started may begin; the unscheduled remainder must not start.
failure_mode: A gather/universal pattern leaks queued tasks into execution on cancellation.
